title: 3P IP Adapter: Frame
slide_intent: Separate guest content from host identification so viewers can recognize both without confusing their roles.
strategic_value: A repeated Twitch stage beneath Pokémon characters can give third-party entertainment a coherent platform setting.
demonstration: An annotated street-poster photograph labels the central Pokémon characters and the Twitch signature beneath them as separate parts of the composition.
practical_value: Compare the role of the host signature with the role of licensed character imagery.

content_islands.name: Flanking information posters
content_islands.spec: Place matching Twitch signatures above large event information on the left and right.

content_islands.name: Character and stage
content_islands.spec: Center Pokémon imagery above a lower Twitch signature; preserve the orange character box, crossed diagonals and stage annotation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying 3P IP Adapter caption explains that framing lets third-party content coexist clearly with the brand.
reference_purposes.Application: The annotated example distinguishes character content from the Twitch stage in a Pokémon promotion.

ingredient.name: Twitch stage beneath guest imagery
ingredient.role: Identify the platform while allowing guest entertainment to remain the focal subject.
ingredient.application: Keep guest imagery and the host signature visually distinct, as demonstrated by the character/stage annotation.
ingredient.scope: Observed in the historical COLLINS identity case study; no mandatory dimensions, color proportions or universal placement rule is supplied.
